actual_pcm_analysis.interpretation: Exact PCM values at +/-32767 (or -32768) indicate saturation/limiting candidates. Recorder clamps floats to [-1,1]; this count cannot identify where upstream saturation occurred or establish perceptual distortion.

audio_sync_caveat: Callback absolute Stopwatch clocks identify listener replacement gaps. The first callback is bracketed by actual observations; its midpoint estimates the initial video offset. PCM boundary is inferred from maximum cumulative-written minus current-listener-produced sample frames. DSP block latency/device output latency remains unknown. No missing PCM is synthesized. Review originals before interpreting exact A/V exposure.

actual_vfr_mux.video_method: Real ffconcat frame durations, millisecond input timebase, VFR H264 at 960px width. Each actual frame is held until the next actual timestamp; last real image held until recording stop. No interpolation.
actual_vfr_mux.audio_method: Actual WAV encoded AAC. Piecewise PCM sample-clock timestamp offsets preserve inferred listener replacement gap; no apad/aresample/async, generated PCM or missing-audio synthesis. AAC packet/block rounding and player gap handling remain limitations.
actual_vfr_mux.packet_timing_caveat: MP4 represents AAC gaps by extended packet duration until the next packet timestamp. Decoder/player gap behavior can differ; original WAV and callback-clock evidence are authoritative. No gap-filling PCM filter was used.
